02 / The coordination work

What happens after the field report is submitted?

Service manager
Does someone in the office rewrite what the technician already recorded before the report can go to the client?
Maintenance manager
When the shift changes, how does the team know which job was left unfinished and where to find the latest reliable information?
Health and safety manager
Of the actions marked as completed, which ones are still waiting for someone to verify the evidence?
Operations director
If this contract grows or you take on another site, which administrative task grows with it?

How we’ll know if it’s worth it

For each pilot, we sample the current work and compare it with the new workflow, including review time and ongoing costs. You can then decide whether it frees up coordination hours, gets client reports out sooner or gives you capacity to take on another contract.

03 / Approach

One workflow. One measurable pilot.

We study your workflow, check which tools can connect and implement the solution if the pilot makes a business case. You can start with TicTAP, a CMMS, an ERP or another inspection tool.

  1. 01

    See how you work today

    We talk to both the person who writes the field report and the person who receives it. We look at sources, access and duplicated work.

  2. 02

    Test with real records

    Once data handling and permissions are agreed, we test an authorised sample, including incomplete or conflicting records.

  3. 03

    Compare time, quality and exceptions

    We cross-check the results against the source, count corrections and include the time your team spends reviewing.

  4. 04

    Agree what goes live and who oversees it

    We clarify permissions, responsibilities, alerts, how to pause the workflow and when to get help. Your team gets a hands-on session.

05 / FAQs

Before you start

What can I do if I already use TicTAP?

You can use Note Taker to fill in forms by voice and add the Stock plugin to record material movements. We can look at using the reports and inspections you already log to build a client-specific report, shift handover or action follow-up.

Can you work with our CMMS or ERP?

You don’t have to use TicTAP. We check what your maintenance system, ERP or inspection tool supports, including exports, APIs, permissions and data quality. We only propose integrations that are feasible for your case.

What happens if information is missing or the AI gets it wrong?

The workflow flags missing fields and conflicting records and keeps the original source at hand so someone can correct the draft. Before connecting anything, we agree which data is processed, which tools are used and who can access it.

Who reviews health and safety actions?

A competent professional assesses the risk and sets the action, owner and deadline. The authorised person verifies the evidence and approves closure. AI organises information; it does not assess risks, authorise work or close actions on its own.

How are the pilot and ongoing maintenance priced?

Before we start, we agree the scope and itemise the pilot, tools and ongoing maintenance. Your team gets a guide and a hands-on session. Any continuing support is agreed separately.
